exception: Exactly the two listed car physical_identity JSONs, each <=8MiB; all other reads <=2MiB. No bag/model/trace/native/WSL access.

time_grid.semantics: Fixed 0.1 s cells anchored at the first explicit REQUEST, ending at the last recorded /clock (final partial cell retained). Each cell belongs to the task active at its start; all REQUESTs are registered even without a snapshot or CONFIRMED event. Before confirmation, after CLEAR/RESET, at a task boundary, or without fresh independent identity evidence the cell is UNKNOWN. No cross-cell interpolation/forward fill. Any known wrong match in the cell takes precedence; otherwise all identity evidence must be known and correct for CORRECT. This measures conservative recorded evidence coverage, not continuous physical identity certainty. Legacy diagnostic-frame metrics remain separate.

diagnostic_frame_identity.semantics: Unknown/occluded frames remain in total; retention_lower_bound is not the same as conditional agreement. UUID partitions explicit tasks and never supplies physical identity.

cases.label_protocol: Exact-source-time independent static render mesh projection, Gazebo actor and camera GT. Physical-gimbal recordings use bracketed independent actual camera-link/vehicle GT cross-checked against bracketed local feedback TF, never a static mount or latest/command pose. Missing dynamic geometry remains unknown and in selected-task denominators; frames without complete independent GT are unscorable in MOT rather than invented empty-GT false positives. Full/amodal metrics are explicitly diagnostic. The unoccluded geometry subset requires all three targets fully in frame, no pair of GT boxes with IoU>.01, and outside +/-1s shutter guards. Independent visual review remains necessary to publish as visible detection labels.
cases.freshness_protocol: Only non-projected track snapshots with matched=true count as detected tracks. Empty diagnostic frames remain in denominator; stale stored boxes cannot become true positives.
cases.selected_identity_protocol: Expected actor is established independently from the user's/test script's REQUEST box at its recorded source image_stamp_s, never from the tracker-selected box. Missing source time or uncertain request-to-GT mapping makes the task UNKNOWN. Each fresh selected track box is independently compared against that expected actor. Physical matches require a unique full-in-frame IoU>=.5 candidate and no shutter guard. Positive same-class GT-box overlap remains UNKNOWN unless all three expected rigid actor projections/depth bounds and exact-source vehicle/actor/physical-camera geometry exist and the entire chosen mesh is at least strictly 0.05 m in front of every overlapping actor in optical z. Unsupported assets, missing proof, near-plane geometry and overlapping depth intervals remain UNKNOWN. This sufficient static-scene proof is neither a nearest-depth actor choice nor runtime completeness evidence. No highest-IoU shortcut or UUID identity inference; MOT denominators/subsets are unchanged.
cases.metric_reference: Portable HOTA/IDF1/CLEAR implementation validated against pinned official TrackEval formulas on 60 random 15-frame sequences, all 19 HOTA alpha values; see research_validation/trackeval_comparison.json
cases.observed_id_switch_boundary: The copied observed_physical_identity_switches_within_task=0 is conditional on known recorded matches inside each explicit task. UNKNOWN gaps are not certified, and explicit new tasks partition the metric; true switches during UNKNOWN remain unidentifiable from these labels.

time_grid_difference_active_minus_stage2.interpretation: Description of these two different development scenes only; not a paired causal gimbal effect or a statistical estimate.

denominator_boundary: Frame rows are diagnostic-image opportunities inside explicit tasks. Fixed 0.1s cells span first REQUEST to last recorded /clock, including request-confirmation waits, loss/hover and gaps; final partial cell retained. No interpolation, forward-fill, FOLLOW-only filtering or zero substitution. Counts from the two populations cannot be added.
phase_stratification: Original reasons do not distinguish TAKEOFF/FOLLOW/HOVER within these unknown classes; no flight-phase counts inferred.
labels_and_truth: Original labels are independent offline static render-mesh projections from exact-source actor/camera GT and guarded geometry. Known gimbal camera geometry does not certify physical identity visibility. This read did not inspect images or perform the independent visible-label review required by the original label protocol.
new_data_boundary: This supplement resolves the already-recorded car reason breakdown without a new flight. Old UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN; formal repeated-seed reliability and paired estimator/gimbal claims still need the planned new batch.
